speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing hand tremors and issues with your memory. To help me understand what might be causing this, could you tell me how long these symptoms have been present and if you have noticed any other changes, such as difficulty walking or speaking?

speaker: Patient
text: 70-year-old man accompanied by his wife. The patient first noticed the tremor in his left hand 1 year ago, which has been progressively worsening. Recently, he has faced difficulty in performing tasks that require steadiness, such as reading. His wife has observed a decline in his memory, taking note of his forgetfulness in paying bills, a task she has since had to assume.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. To help narrow down the cause, could you tell me if the tremor is present when your hand is completely at rest, or does it only happen when you are trying to use it, like when you are holding a cup? Also, have you noticed any stiffness in your limbs or a slowing down of your movements?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Resting tremor worse on the left hand. I also have Soft speech, Reduced facial expressions, Memory decline, Difficulty in managing finances.

speaker: Doctor
text: Those symptoms, particularly the resting tremor, soft speech, and reduced facial expression, are highly characteristic of Parkinson's disease. I would like to confirm if you have also experienced any issues with balance, such as feeling unsteady when standing or walking.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Hypertension, medicated with aspirin and amlodipine. Family history of schizophrenia in his mother. No other significant medical or psychiatric history. Social history: Drinks 1-2 beers nightly and is a former cigar smoker.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that history. I would now like to perform a physical examination to check for rigidity in your muscles and assess your gait stability. REQUEST TEST: Neurological_Exam
